configuration.cv: leave-one-physical-condition-out over 8 training (L,particle,angle) groups; all four repeats and both bits stay grouped
configuration.selection_score: arithmetic mean of per-fold RMSE for each bit/target independently
configuration.tie_break: lowest alpha among scores within 1e-12 target units of minimum
configuration.standardization: training fold population mean/std only; zero std replaced with1; final fit uses all training data
configuration.ridge_objective: sum_squared_error + alpha*sum(coef**2); intercept unpenalized; alpha0 via least-squares
configuration.required_training: all 64 training bit responses audited; unresolved outcome blocks prediction freeze
configuration.freeze_before_test: model coefficients/scalers/config, all test input Geant4 events and matched baselines, per-event predictions and SHA256 before any holdout/extrapolation TCAD response
configuration.scope: predict TCAD response given actual Geant4 deposition and known unirradiated baselines; oxide extension excluded from length prediction scores

implementation.linear_algebra: numpy lstsq(rcond=None) for alpha0; solve otherwise
